# Professional Description

Soergel Abell Arnold & Davis, LLC is an established court reporting and deposition videography firm serving Kentucky and surrounding states since 1973. They offer comprehensive services including realtime reporting, video synchronization, expedited transcripts, litigation support, and 24-hour availability to meet all deposition needs. With experienced partners and videographers, the firm delivers specialized solutions such as condensed transcripts with indices, ASCII files in various litigation support formats, and audio/video transcription services.
